Administration

Manage user access, installers and the location hierarchy.

Add users and assign Admin, Editor or Installer access.

Installer names

Create the approved Installer list first. These names will be available for Panchayat or Village assignment and in the record-form dropdowns.

Assign Installer to Panchayat or Village

Leave Village blank to make the Installer available for every Village in the selected Panchayat.

Location hierarchy directory

Create Division → Sub Division → Section → Panchayat → Village. Select or type names in order; lower levels may be left blank and added later. Existing unassigned locations are kept separately.

Set the Section Warehouse distance once for the section. Set the site distance once for each village. Saving updates matching consumer records.

Select a section to view saved distances.

Monthly Incentives

Admin-only rates and Excel report

Each consumer installed in this month earns one Registration, Survey and Installation incentive. Records without an Installation Date are excluded.

Incentive per installed consumer: ₹0

Rates are saved separately for each month. Enter 0 if a stage has no incentive.

The installation amount is divided into three shares for Installer1–3. Missing names leave that share unassigned. Any rounding paise are allocated to Installer1, then Installer2. The report includes installer-wise totals.
